name: conversation-history
purpose: The chat list of an assistant, in a side panel or a `Drawer` on phones: rows grouped by last activity (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days, Older) or by status (Working, Settled), the open one current, pinned chats on top, an optional Projects section of folders that expand in place, and on top a New chat row, a search field or a toolbar whose Search button opens the app's palette. A row is a title or a rich row (tag, description, age, status); per-row actions (pin, rename, share, lock, move, archive, delete) sit on hover and in a `DropdownMenu`. Choosing a row sets `v-model` to its id.
useWhen: An assistant keeps past conversations and the person returns to one.
The left rail or a drawer of a chat page.
related: `conversation` — shows the conversation the history selects.
`drawer` — holds the history on narrow screens.
bestPractices: Title each conversation from its first prompt, short.
Put it beside the conversation on wide screens and in a start-side `Drawer` on phones; close the drawer from `update:modelValue` and `create`.
Fix `now` on the app's `ConfigProvider` (or here) so groups and ages match on the server and the client.
The component never changes `items`: apply each action event to the data (flip `pinned`, `archived`, `locked`, set `projectId`, the new `title`).
Never delete on the first tap: open a `ConfirmDialog` from `remove` / `project-remove`, or remove at once and offer Undo.
With `showToolbar`, open the app's `Command` palette from `search-open`; a mounted `Command` claims ⌘K, so the Search button does not bind it twice.

props.name: items
props.doc: Conversations, any order; sorted newest first in their group or project.

props.name: projects
props.doc: Projects shown in a Projects section above Recents; empty keeps the plain groups.

props.name: now
props.doc: Reference time for groups and ages. Empty uses the nearest ConfigProvider now, then the current time.

props.name: removable
props.doc: Lets each row be deleted (emits `remove`): a Delete button, or Delete in the row menu when `itemActions` is set.

props.name: creatable
props.doc: Shows New chat (a row, or a toolbar button with `showToolbar`) that emits `create`.

props.name: projectCreatable
props.doc: Shows New project (in the Projects header, or the toolbar) that emits `project-create`.

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Shows a search field that hides conversations whose title does not contain the typed text.

props.name: showToolbar
props.doc: Shows a top toolbar: a Search button that emits `search-open`, then New project and New chat as icon buttons.

props.name: itemActions
props.doc: Row actions: a Pin button and a More menu on each row; `move` needs `projects`.

props.name: projectActions
props.doc: Project row actions: a More menu (pin, settings, remove) and a New chat button (`chat-create`).

props.name: groupBy
props.doc: Groups chats outside projects by last activity, or into Working (`status: 'running'`) and Settled (the rest and archived chats).

props.name: showTime
props.doc: Shows each chat's age (`10m`, `15h`, `3d`) at the end of its row.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows placeholder rows while the history loads.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Conversation history`).

events.name: item-rename
events.payload: (event: KeyboardEvent | FocusEvent, payload: { item; title: string })

slots.name: item
slots.notes: Replaces a chat row's tag, title and description; the row keeps its button and actions.

slots.name: item-meta
slots.notes: Replaces the end of a chat row (age, lock, status).

slots.name: item-actions
slots.notes: Replaces the row actions (Pin, More, Delete) with the app's own controls, outside the row button; they show like the built-in actions. The row content keeps its place while they show; set `--conversation-history-item-actions-width` on the list to make the row end that wide while they show (default: the row's own end padding, so nothing moves).
